title: RC520 native IG831T platform, USB and network reference

scope.classification: CONFIRMED_NATIVE_HOST with per-field source and uncertainty boundaries

unresolved: Runtime dongle generation or identity decision

interfaces.role: Serial binding observed; selected native RIL AT role is interface 3
Native RIL AT selection supported by source and boot exchanges
Native QMI control and network association

functional_descriptors.interpretation: Original references are reported without repairing them. Vendor interface class plus CDC functional descriptors does not by itself assign every port a role.

usb.host_topology: Internal DWC3/xHCI USB host path through a hub; bus/device numbers and physical path instance are omitted.
usb.external_controller_usb_mode: The controller-to-computer MTP/bulk/ADB function is separate from the internal modem.

kernel.load_form_limit: These selected y configuration symbols are built-in. Presence under sys/module alone does not prove dynamic module loading; the exact vendor qmi_wwan_f symbol-to-object mapping is unknown.

nodes.actual_fd_owner: UNKNOWN; protected descriptors/maps were not bypassed
nodes.access_limit: The observed node path requires suitable DAC and security permissions. Ordinary app membership in radio/bluetooth groups is not assumed.

declarations.declaration_conflict: System declaration adds disabled; vendor declaration does not. Import/override precedence unresolved.

init.dialer_parentage_limit: A parent of init does not establish direct init launch; reparenting is possible.
init.route_trigger: sys.dji.route can restart link, WLM slave, LTE and configuration-store services; not exercised by the collector.

network_name_edge.source_consumer: fibocom-dial main reads the property, takes its nonempty branch and stores the adapter name

property_inventory.mailbox_boundary: A command/status provider remains in dji_lte, but the selected native RIL has no exact literal occurrence of the 14 examined mailbox/status names. Dynamic names or other producers remain possible; runtime provider selection is unknown.
property_inventory.lifetime_boundary: No generic owner, transaction freshness or automatic process-death cleanup was established. A property name is not a safe temporary IPC contract.
property_inventory.value_export_exception: Only the fixed generic adapter name dji_mini_net is included in network_name_edge.

security.scope: Current implementation properties, not universal requirements for every replacement
security.offline_policy_method: Local libsepol 3.6 type-enforcement queries against separately saved active and precompiled policy files. No property or node operation executed.
security.runtime_per_property_contexts: NOT_CAPTURED; inventory context labels come from captured rules
limits: Type-enforcement results do not cover all DAC, Android, service-level or extended ioctl checks.
Permissive mode can change enforcement behavior; it does not grant arbitrary operations or prove a write succeeded.
Root processes and radio-group nodes do not prove that a replacement must use root or permissive SELinux.

binder.method: Existing Binder/process tracepoints; no app hooks

android_network.middle_chain_limit: RIL, phone process, system services and a cellular NetworkAgent are supported by separate records; no complete method/parcel sequence was decoded.

observation_limits.boot_log_scope: Finite early-boot protocol window; collector duration is not continuous log coverage.
